""" from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function, unicode_literals import justext from justext import get_stoplist, get_stoplists from justext.core import html_to_dom, preprocessor, decode_html HTML_PAGE = """ A Test Page

This is a Page Title

  • Home
  • About
  • Contact
  • Products

This is the first real paragraph of the page and it contains a lot of the useful information that we want to keep in the extracted text because it is the main content of the page.

This is the second real paragraph of the page. The jusText library is designed to extract exactly this kind of text from the web pages and it should be able to keep it in the output of the extraction.

And this is the third real paragraph which is also full of words that are very common in the English language, so it is quite easy for the algorithm to tell that this is the real content of the page.

© 2024. All rights reserved.
""" def _extract(html=HTML_PAGE): stoplist = get_stoplist("English") return justext.justext(html, stoplist) def test_main_body_is_retained(): """All paragraphs of the main body are extracted as good content.""" paragraphs = _extract() good_texts = [p.text for p in paragraphs if not p.is_boilerplate] assert any("first real paragraph" in text for text in good_texts) assert any("second real paragraph" in text for text in good_texts) assert any("third real paragraph" in text for text in good_texts) def test_boilerplate_is_removed(): """Navigation, footer, scripts, styles and comments are removed.""" paragraphs = _extract() good_texts = [p.text for p in paragraphs if not p.is_boilerplate] all_texts = [p.text for p in paragraphs] #
